description: This file defines React components for rendering SVG icons representing players in a Tic-Tac-Toe game, specifically icons for 'X' as a knight and 'O' as a queen, with accessibility features and styling.

methods.name: PlayerIcon
methods.description: Renders an icon representing a player ('X' as knight, 'O' as queen) with accessible labels.

methods.name: iconLabelFor
methods.description: Returns an accessible label string for the given player ('X' or 'O').
